description: Post a public update to an incident's publication. Customers see updates newest first. Titles and messages are what customers read: no internal names, repositories, people or other customers. Text the disclosure check stops is refused with disclosure_hits_remaining and the hits; reword it. Acts as you, with the same checks as the Console; a service account's key is refused. Requires `write` scope.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

ifRevision.description: The revision you read. A stale one is refused (publication_modified / maintenance_modified); read again and retry.

status.description: resolved resolves it on the page; another status after that reopens it.

name: anyforge_post_status_page_update
title: Post status page update
